english.note: Use 推 as the all-purpose verb for physically moving something away, and colloquially for actively promoting an idea or product.
Use this for physically pushing or propelling something, especially when it is moved away or in a particular direction.

exampleSentences.english: I force the table against the wall by pushing it.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 lik6 teoi1 zoeng1 toi2 maai4 coeng4 bin1

english.note: Use 推 when you cause something to move by pushing it, including when a force pushes it.

exampleSentences.english: Help me move this table by pushing it aside.
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 teoi1 hoi1 zoeng1 toi4
